parameters.name: PolicyDocument
parameters.description: The document of the policy. The document can be up to 6,144 bytes in length.

parameters.name: RotateStrategy
parameters.description:
The rotation strategy of the policy. The rotation strategy can be used to delete an early policy version.

Valid values:

*   `None`: disables the rotation strategy.
*   `DeleteOldestNonDefaultVersionWhenLimitExceeded`: deletes the earliest non-active version if the number of versions exceeds the limit.

Default value: `None`.

parameters.name: SetAsDefault
parameters.description: Specifies whether to set this policy as the default policy. Default value: `false`.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ram create-policy-version --policy-name OSS-Administrator --policy-document Statement_:_Action_:_oss:0_,_Effect_:_Allow_,_Resource_:_acs:oss:0:0:0_,_Version_:_1 --set-as-default false --rotate-strategy None --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ram CreatePolicyVersion --region cn-hangzhou --SetAsDefault false --PolicyName 'OSS-Administrator' --PolicyDocument 'Statement_:_Action_:_oss:0_,_Effect_:_Allow_,_Resource_:_acs:oss:0:0:0_,_Version_:_1' --RotateStrategy None
